name: Mute Indicator
description: See at a glance when your kiosk's microphone is muted, even on the screensaver. Show a mute symbol, a red glow that fades in from the edges or corners, or both, each with its own position, size, colour and opacity. Follows the kiosk's own Voice Satellite mute by default, so it keeps working when Home Assistant is offline, or any Home Assistant entity you choose. Touches always pass straight through.
author: MessyBob

settings.title: Follow
settings.description: This kiosk follows Voice Satellite's microphone mute directly. It is the same mute as the kiosk's VS Mute switch in Home Assistant, and it keeps working when Home Assistant is offline. Choose Home Assistant entity to follow any entity instead.

settings.title: Entity
settings.description: The entity that says whether the kiosk is muted, such as switch.echo_show_8_vs_mute.

settings.title: Muted when the state is
settings.description: The state that means muted. Separate several with commas, such as on, muted. Unknown and unavailable never count as muted.

settings.title: Indicator
settings.description: A mute symbol, a coloured glow from the screen's edges or corners, or both.

settings.title: Show
options: Only when the screensaver is off
settings.description: Everywhere covers the dashboard, the screensaver, the menu and camera views.

settings.title: Fade in and out (ms)
settings.description: How long the indicator takes to fade in when the kiosk is muted and to fade out when it is unmuted.

settings.title: Pulse while muted
settings.description: Gently pulse the indicator instead of holding it steady. Pulsing redraws the screen continuously, which uses more power on slower devices.

settings.title: Preview while editing
settings.description: Show the indicator for 15 seconds when you open these settings, on the kiosk or in Remote Admin, and again after each change, so you can see the result. It hides on its own, and at once when you close the page.

settings.title: Move right (dp)
settings.description: Fine-tune the position. Negative moves left. The icon always stays on screen.

settings.title: Move down (dp)
settings.description: Fine-tune the position. Negative moves up. The icon always stays on screen.

settings.title: Opacity (%)
settings.description: Applies to the symbol and its background together.

settings.title: Background
settings.description: A shape behind the symbol keeps it readable over photos and bright dashboards.

settings.title: Position
settings.description: Where the glow starts. It is strongest there and fades to clear.

settings.title: Size (dp)
settings.description: How far the glow reaches into the screen from its edge or corner.

settings.title: Opacity (%)
settings.description: How strong the glow is at the edge.
